levels.name: Professional Foundation
levels.scope: non-production experiments without production data, credentials or external SLA

targets.nist_ssdf: selected applicable PO, PS, PW and RV outcomes
targets.owasp_asvs: applicability assessment; selected requirements when a web/API surface exists
targets.openssf_osps: Level 1 when the project is public open source

levels.name: Controlled Engineering
levels.scope: internal tools and persistent team systems

targets.nist_ssdf: applicable SSDF 1.1 practices with recorded gaps

levels.name: High-Assurance Product
levels.scope: supported products, public interfaces and integrations

targets.nist_ssdf: all applicable SSDF 1.1 tasks mapped to evidence
targets.openssf_osps: highest applicable level, normally Level 2 for multi-maintainer code projects

targets.nist_ssdf: all applicable SSDF 1.1 tasks continuously evidenced
targets.owasp_asvs: Level 2 minimum and Level 3 for high-value security functions
targets.openssf_osps: highest applicable level, at least Level 2 for qualifying public projects

levels.name: Critical Trust
levels.scope: identity, authorization, sensitive data, critical infrastructure, irreversible migration or high-consequence autonomy

targets.nist_ssdf: all applicable SSDF 1.1 tasks plus SP 800-218A when AI-applicable, independently verified
targets.openssf_osps: Level 3 when applicability conditions are met; otherwise all applicable lower-level controls plus documented gap review
